title: Keep incident policies v1 (contract; runtime implementation 20/24-29/21)

Id.description: Stable logical ID, scoped by tenant and resource kind.

TeamId.description: Existing TeamPolicy ID; never inferred from a destination.

TeamOrUnassigned.description: Null selects only unassigned data, never all teams.

FieldPath.description: Event/normalized field path. Canonical security fields are not writable.

SourcePath.description: Source path; quoted dictionary keys support Kubernetes label aliases.

SecretRef.description: Reference only; resolved on the server, never placed in wire payload or preview.

Endpoint.description: HTTP(S) endpoint without credentials, query or fragment; HTTP is for the lab/private network.

HttpsEndpoint.description: HTTP(S) endpoint without credentials, query or fragment; HTTP is for the lab/private network.

LabIdentityEndpoint.description: HTTP only for loopback/private Kubernetes identity in the lab; JWT verification remains mandatory.

IdentityEndpoint.description: HTTPS issuer/JWKS, or explicit local lab identity address.

LinkUrl.description: Rendered HTTP(S) URL; public query parameters/fragments are allowed, credentials are forbidden.

UtcTime.description: UTC RFC3339 time with Z; server time controls silence coverage.

Cel.description: CEL over the documented canonical event context; invalid syntax is rejected.

TeamRefs.description: Explicit team scope; null only for unassigned.

SilenceEventTypes.description: Service events bypass ordinary notification suppression.

path.description: File relative to bundle directory; no traversal or symlink escape.

sha256.description: Digest of exact file bytes; missing/changed artifacts reject the whole bundle.

items.description: Exact OIDC group; use the full path returned by the issuer.

groups.description: Membership groups, separate from role groups.

zones.description: Zones owned by exactly one team.

visible_to.description: Reader team IDs; omitted means own team. Does not grant writes.

items.description: Exact OIDC role group; unknown groups grant no role.

admin.description: Existing admin role; no new role registry.

items.description: Exact OIDC role group; unknown groups grant no role.

responder.description: Existing responder role; no new role registry.

items.description: Exact OIDC role group; unknown groups grant no role.

viewer.description: Existing viewer role; no new role registry.

items.description: Exact OIDC role group; unknown groups grant no role.

noc.description: Existing noc role; no new role registry.

id.description: Unique view ID; all is reserved for the automatic ALL view.

cel.description: Extra CEL filter; never grants access.

visibility.description: Existing read visibility policy; writes still require membership.

MappingManifest.x-change: new events only; ownership migration needs a reviewed plan

name.description: Existing mapping name; does not replace the bundle logical ID.

priority.description: Existing mapping priority; larger value wins.

rows.description: Existing mapping rows; arbitrary event attributes except canonical security fields.

Extract.x-change: new events; identity changes require migration preview

pattern.description: Regex applied to the first nonempty source; no implicit pod-name regex.

mode.description: Unknown keeps missing diagnostics; literal is an explicit configured fallback.

value.description: Literal fallback for non-security fields only.

NormalizedField.x-change: new events; identity changes require migration preview

name.description: Normalized output only; tenant/team/role/fingerprint cannot be targets.

sources.description: Aliases in priority order; first non-null, nonempty value wins.

Normalization.x-change: new events; preserve original event and value provenance

fields.description: One rule owns each normalized output per match.

presentation_ref.description: Optional presentation used in Keep before notification routing.

DisplayField.x-change: render next projection, preserve manual text

order.description: Display order; ties retain declaration order.

url_template.description: HTTP(S) or Keep link template; never a credential/reference expansion.

ActionPresentation.x-change: next projection; action permission always comes from canonical RBAC

command.description: Canonical action, no custom privileged operation.

label.description: Configured button/link label; array position defines order.

Presentation.x-change: next UI/notification projection; user_summary and notes remain unchanged

title.description: Existing mustache-style template over permitted canonical fields.

description.description: Generated description, separate from operator notes.

links.description: Optional documentation, dashboard and Keep links.

actions.description: Interactive actions or explicit Keep-link fallback.

severity_colors.description: Optional rendering colors; omitted means no color.

collections.description: Configured linked-alert display data, generated by Keep.

source_links.description: Configured linked-alert display data, generated by Keep.

prefer_active_alerts.description: Show active linked alerts, or all linked alerts when none are active.

Reopen.x-change: existing episode pins policy; next episode uses active revision

mode.description: Reuse ID within window or create a linked new incident.

within_seconds.description: Half-open reopen window after resolution; outside creates a new incident.

Flapping.x-change: existing episode pins policy; next episode uses active revision

enabled.description: Enable flapping classification; transition audit is always retained.

window_seconds.description: Sliding policy-clock window, lower bound excluded.

transition_threshold.description: Distinct firing/resolved transitions; duplicates do not count.

reset_after_seconds.description: Quiet time after last transition clears classification and window history.

Lifecycle.x-change: existing episode pins policy; next episode uses active revision

resolve_on.description: Existing Rule.resolve_on values; canonical linked alerts only.

clock.description: Canonical timestamp basis; original time is still stored.

late_event_policy.description: Older events never roll back newer state; kept in history.

Correlation.x-change: new groups/episodes; no implicit regrouping of open incidents

priority.description: Higher priority first; ties within a team are rejected.

group_by.description: Ordered typed tuple plus mandatory tenant/team/rule scope.

missing_required.description: Never join missing required values under a shared null key.

window_seconds.description: Join window in seconds; equality at upper bound opens a new group.

threshold.description: Minimum distinct alerts before incident creation.

multi_level.description: Expand the values of one dictionary group_by path into distinct scoped groups.

multi_level_property_name.description: Path within each dictionary entry, required when multi_level is true.

Retry.x-change: next attempt rechecks active destination and canonical state

max_attempts.description: Total attempts including the initial send.

Delivery.x-change: next attempt rechecks active destination and canonical state

debounce_seconds.description: Ordinary notifications only; lifecycle silence events are never collapsed.

Dispatch.x-change: worker reload; time-based silence coverage is always evaluated at request/send time

scan_interval_seconds.description: Outbox/time-transition scan cadence; never extends the silence interval.

lease_seconds.description: Per-delivery worker lease; renew/verify ownership before sending.

Capabilities.x-change: validate against registered adapter; cannot invent capabilities

update.description: Can edit one existing incident projection.

receipts.description: Returns a recoverable external message identity.

thread.description: Can create a reply under a confirmed root post.

Transport.x-change: next send; switching transports does not change domain policy

adapter_ref.description: Contract catalog profile; implementation follows in 29/21.

auth_ref.description: Null only for explicitly public/lab outgoing receivers.

callback_client_ref.description: Registered service client; required for interactive actions.

channel_id.description: External channel ID only, no role or Keep team inference.

path.description: Relative receiver path without credentials, query or traversal.

Destination.x-change: next send; team reassignment requires reviewed migration

options.description: Options selected by the referenced adapter, validated by profile.

ContactAddress.x-change: next notification; operator/role identity is separate

EscalationLevel.x-change: current episode keeps deadlines/contacts; next episode uses active revision

after_seconds.description: Offset from SLA origin; levels strictly increasing.

repeat_limit.description: Total level executions; 0 repeats until the next level or stop condition, 1 disables repeat.

Reminder.x-change: current episode pins policy; next episode uses active revision

Ticket.x-change: new idempotent operation; manual links preserved

url_template.description: Ticket link template; credentials remain in workflow secret references.

enrichment_key.description: Incident metadata key; an existing manual value always wins.

Automation.x-change: current episode pins policy; explicit reschedule plan required to change existing jobs

sla_start.description: Clock origin for ACK deadline and level offsets.

ack_deadline_seconds.description: ACK deadline relative to SLA origin.

on_reopen.description: New incident always resets; continuing only for same-ID episode.

on_policy_update.description: Next episode pins the active policy; reschedule replaces the current chain from its existing SLA origin; cancel stops the current chain.

execution_lease_seconds.description: Worker lease renewed before each provider attempt; an expired execution with a started effect is uncertain and never automatically replayed.

match.description: Public normalized/incident condition; false stops SLA/operations without changing correlation.

Route.x-change: next projection/retry; skipped history is never replayed; after_silence optionally sends current active state

priority.description: Higher priority first; team/event ties reject.

destination_refs.description: Independent fan-out; every destination must belong to a selected team.

delivery_mode.description: One canonical incident per destination; no arbitrary aggregation.

update_fallback.description: Explicit behavior when adapter cannot update.

actions_fallback.description: Without trusted buttons, require login/confirmation in Keep.

after_silence.description: On observed silence suppression ending, send one fresh incident.updated projection if still firing/acknowledged. Skipped history and SLA remain unchanged. Applies to every transport.

initial_delivery.description: active_only creates a new destination binding only for a firing/acknowledged incident; existing confirmed bindings still receive resolution. Rechecked before sending.

ProofProfile.x-change: next command; revocation does not rewrite prior audit

items.description: Allowed client ID in the configured party claim.

groups_claim.description: Exact claim containing group paths consumed by the existing TeamPolicy.

username_claim.description: Verified claim for the Keep username/assignee; null uses sub. A configured claim must be present.

required_claims.description: Explicit token profile, e.g. typ: Bearer.

jwks_timeout_seconds.description: Trusted JWKS fetch timeout; fail closed on unavailable keys.

jwks_cache_seconds.description: Bounded public-key cache lifetime; unknown kid triggers refresh.

ServiceClient.x-change: next command; user proof and canonical authorization remain mandatory

origin.description: Origin registered here, never copied from command body.

proof_profile_refs.description: Trusted actor-proof profiles; required for delegated mutation scopes.

items.description: Service permission ceiling, intersected with user scopes/team ownership.

scopes.description: No admin wildcard or generic impersonation.

Subscriber.x-change: new outbox events; disable stops delivery, not audit

destination_refs.description: Same-team independent receivers; failure never rolls back the silence.

Removal.x-change: reviewed deletion of configuration only; operator/history state is never deleted

kind.description: Resource kind in the previously active managed snapshot.

id.description: Previously managed logical ID; no name-based adoption/deletion.

expected_resource_digest.description: Must equal the previously applied resource digest in preview/apply 24.

api_version.description: Bundle version; independent of wire schema_version.

kind.description: Explicit future bundle, never a legacy loader input.

tenant_id.description: Must equal the trusted deployment/apply tenant.

revision.description: Operator label; canonical digest, not this string, identifies exact content.

keep_url.description: Public Keep URL for fallback actions/links.

access.description: Exactly one existing TeamPolicy document; no second role/team registry.

correlation_overlap.description: First match picks highest priority; parallel keeps distinct rule scope.

routing_overlap.description: Fanout evaluates all matches, deduplicating destination IDs.

subscribers.description: Silence lifecycle subscriptions; not ordinary routes.

deletions.description: Omission alone never deletes a managed resource; requires matching previous digest.

adoptions.description: Explicit internal ID and current resource digest; no name-based adoption.

notification_defaults.description: Global notification settings; omitted values inherit existing route behavior.

notification_policies.description: Deterministic team, route, family and escalation-level overrides.

ReadyField.x-change: projection from latest permitted canonical state

value.description: Ready sanitized value; no transport derivation.

ReadyAction.x-change: verified command or Keep confirmation; never actor from context

ReadyLink.x-change: rendered in Keep before delivery; adapter never expands templates

Notification.x-change: rebuild before each ordinary send/retry; silence gate on canonical data

schema_version.description: Wire version, aligned with silence v1.

description.description: Ready description projected from uncovered data only.

color.description: Ready configured color; null means no color. Adapter does not infer severity.

links.description: Rendered links: templates must already be expanded.

contact_refs.description: Chosen contacts; address resolution belongs to adapter.

projection_revision.description: Monotonic rendered projection version; incident_revision is the command CAS version.

IncidentCommand.x-change: one canonical authorized optimistic state transition

expected_revision.description: Stale state is a conflict, never silently overwritten.

command.description: Silence commands reuse the existing v1 schemas/routes.

assignee.description: Assign value; must resolve to a permitted Keep user.

DeliveryReceipt.x-change: delivery metadata only; does not ACK/resolve the incident

status.description: Unknown after timeout is not confirmed delivery.

external_id.description: Opaque adapter ID, never mandatory in notification/command.

delivered_revision.description: Last confirmed projected revision; null when not confirmed.

RuntimeOwnership.x-change: reviewed cutover; gates affect the Keep runtime only

domain.description: Owner of automatic grouping, lifecycle and SLA. Manual commands remain available.

notifications.description: Owner of the new shared incident/silence sender. Rechecked before dispatch.

legacy_snooze.description: Reviewed external bridge snooze owner; Keep cannot stop an unchanged bridge.

MigrationRule.x-change: explicit mapping; a legacy fingerprint is never identity evidence

MigrationPostReceipt.x-change: reviewed read-only transport receipt; old buttons still require retirement

MigrationRoot.x-change: explicit root adoption; split/merge remain a manual plan and do not rewrite history

automation_start.description: New SLA clock; local bridge SLA levels never seed canonical counters.

window_start.description: Start of the adopted correlation window; original creation time and history are retained.

LegacyIncidentMigration.x-change: read-only preview; explicit atomic import with immutable receipts and source/config digests

zones.description: No fallback for unknown legacy zones; canonical owner must match.

post_receipt_max_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of a reviewed read-only receipt for adopting a legacy post.

SourceCollection.x-change: next generated presentation; identity/operator fields unchanged

sources.description: Ordered source fallbacks per linked alert; credential paths forbidden.

max_chars.description: Maximum rendered characters, including truncation indicator.

sources.description: Ordered source fallbacks per linked alert; credential paths forbidden.
